Hero_Desc_DayaPureShine:
Daya became a magical girl to overcome her unapproachable image.
There were a few misunderstandings along the way... but she seems pleased with the result.
She is always waiting for praise from the Master.
Album_Like_DayaPureShine: The Master, attention and encouragement directed at her
Album_Hate_DayaPureShine: Villains, things that turn out to be fake
Album_Hobby_DayaPureShine: Writing love letters to the Master
Album_Wish_DayaPureShine: To become closer to everyone, including the Master
Album_DayaPureShine1: Pure Shine, the magical girl who always sparkles perfectly, appeared one day without warning yet immediately earned everyone's trust. Her haughty speech and glittering presence bring someone to mind... but she believes her double life is flawless, so let us pretend not to notice.
Album_DayaPureShine2: Pure Shine's magical-girl contractor is Eisia. Everything from her costume to her weapon is sponsored by Eisia's company. Pure Shine can occasionally be found sitting on a defeated villain and eating a hard ice cream bar because of these practical adult arrangements.
Album_DayaPureShine3: As the highest-ranked Dragon, she should defeat ordinary villains with ease... Yet her innocence sometimes lets her fall for a villain's underhanded tricks and stumble into danger. In the end, however, she triumphs through overwhelming force. Such is the law of the magical-girl genre.
Album_DayaPureShine4: She recently placed second among the people Monatium citizens respect most. Considering Elena has always held first place, this is a remarkable achievement. Respect does not necessarily make someone approachable... but Daya looks thoroughly satisfied, so perhaps it does not matter.
Album_DayaPureShine5: Handling every duty of both the Dragon leader and Pure Shine sounds exhausting... Yet Daya never lets it show and remains as perfect as ever. When asked her secret, she credits the support and attention of everyone who likes her. Having tasted affection and admiration once, she seems to have developed an appetite for more.
Album_DayaPureShine6: Daya never refuses any request for help, from defeating villains and rescuing Elias residents to finding small lost objects. A magical girl must be kind to everyone. Perhaps she spent too long underground, though, because she sometimes returns completely unrelated objects as lost property and looks proud of herself.
Album_DayaPureShine7: Her newest hobby is keeping a diary in the form of letters. Once she fills an entire notebook, she plans to bind it together with her earlier letters and give the book to me... I wonder what she has written inside.
LoveHero_DayaPureShine: If you call, I shall reach you before anyone else!
LoveHeroCancel_DayaPureShine: I shall wait until you call for me again, Master.
Food_ChefNote_DayaPureShine_Hate1: Seeing the Dragon candy, Daya became deeply saddened that such junk food had apparently become popular among Dragons.
Food_ChefNote_DayaPureShine_Hate2: Daya looked offended by the canned food and declared that the villain who created it must be punished immediately.
Food_ChefNote_DayaPureShine_Like1: After eating the rice cake soup, Daya said she felt ready to work even harder rescuing citizens. She must have liked how hearty it felt.
Food_ChefNote_DayaPureShine_Like2: Daya looked satisfied after drinking the lemon tea. Apparently, its calming effect helps her wait more patiently for letters.
Food_ChefNote_DayaPureShine_Like3: Daya admired the topping gemstones, calling them beautiful because they sparkled like Pure Shine's decorations.
Food_ChefNote_DayaPureShine_Like4: As Daya watched me carefully prepare the buche de Noel, she said she was happy to have an excuse to watch me for so long.
Food_ChefNote_DayaPureShine_Like5: The Tart Vita made Daya's eyes fly open with its intense sourness. She said it would be useful when balancing her duties as Pure Shine and the Dragon leader.
Food_ChefNote_DayaPureShine_Like6: The songpyeon in many colors delighted Daya because they looked like an assortment of gemstones.
Food_ChefNote_DayaPureShine_Like7: Daya was fascinated by the texture of the almond inside the chocolate, saying it felt like biting into a gemstone.
Food_ChefNote_DayaPureShine_Like8: Daya likes most kinds of vitamins. Yum-Yum Vita is her particular favorite because of its sparkling golden color.
Food_ChefNote_DayaPureShine_Like9: When Daya saw the candies themed after each race, she spent a long time praising the Master as a magnificent leader who embraces everyone. That means she liked them, right?

LoveLetter_DayaPureShine:
To the Master.

Master, a sudden worry kept me from sleeping tonight, so I am writing this letter.
After finishing a busy day of magical-girl activities and managing the Dragons, I lay in bed and wondered...
Could carrying out both my work as a magical girl and my duties as the Dragon leader eventually draw me away from you?
It would be absurd, since I became a magical girl in the first place to earn your praise.
Master, please never forget: whether I am Diamond, first among the Dragons, or the magical girl Pure Shine, I am always Daya, longing for your praise.
Let us meet again soon.

Your Daya.
LoveCall_DayaPureShine:
Ah, Master. It is I, your Daya. Thank you for answering.

I called because I want to arrange our next meeting. Hehe.
I know you are busy, so I shall adapt my schedule to yours. When would be convenient?
Hmm, I am a little embarrassed to sound so insistent... but I look forward to seeing you every day, and every parting leaves me so reluctant that I cannot bear not to arrange the next meeting.
Perhaps I have grown accustomed to days spent with you.

You need not decide immediately. Choose a comfortable time and let me know.
I shall happily await your call.
